headline: Samsung launches 1,100Hz dual-mode Odyssey G60H gaming monitor
summary: Samsung launched the Odyssey G60H gaming monitor, which it calls the world's first to hit a 1,100Hz refresh rate. Both outlets agree that top rate is only reachable in HD mode, with a lower 600Hz rate available at QHD resolution.

claims.statement: Samsung launched the dual-mode Odyssey G60H gaming monitor, which reaches 1,100Hz in HD mode.

sources.quote: The Samsung Odyssey G6 G60H is the world's first 1,100Hz gaming monitor
dual-mode Odyssey G60H offers 1,100 Hz in HD

claims.statement: The monitor's top refresh rate is only available in HD resolution, not at higher resolutions.

sources.quote: this monitor's refresh rate only gets that high in HD mode
with QHD 600Hz and HD 1100HZ display modes
